Test protocol, 21 Nov to 19 Dec 2026 (fixed, do not adjust)
These rules are being measured against the journal's own data by Claude Code. They must not change before 19 Dec, or the test is worthless.

1. Entry: when a name crosses 10% above its true previous close, and only if the price is within 5% of session VWAP. If that point has passed, there is no entry.
2. Skip any name that opened 50% or more above its previous close.
3. Exit orders are placed at the moment of the fill: sell limit at +20% from the entry, stop at -15% from the entry. No trailing stop. They are not moved.
4. Flat by the close. No overnight holds. No GTC orders left open.
5. Next-day re-entry only if the name shows a pre-market high 20% or more above the previous close and then crosses +10% again after the open. Same exits.
6. Names with two or more prior spikes in the last 30 trading days: same trade, never held past the target or the close.
7. One trade per stock per day. No re-entry after a stop.
Position size is Sarantis's own decision and is not part of the test.

What Claude does under this protocol: when flagging a name, state the facts for rules 1, 2, 5 and 6: previous close, the +10% price, current price against VWAP, opening gap, pre-market high against previous close, prior spike count; say plainly if the entry point has already passed. Do not suggest structural stops, trail widths, partial exits or a second entry during this period. In each trade review, list the seven rules and mark each 'followed' or 'broke', with the numbers. Claude never places or drafts orders; Sarantis places them himself. Everything else (scan passes, nightly fill, minute bars, filings and news checks) stays as it is.
